voicepack.hank_open_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_open_01.text: Good evening from Scrapyard Lot. Homework and Wreckless, 3 rounds, and this crowd is already on its feet.

voicepack.hank_open_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_open_02.text: We are live at The Drain, where 900, standing came out to watch Monsoon take on Grudge.

voicepack.hank_open_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_open_03.text: Welcome to Harbor Pit. Tonight's main event is Gaff Hook against Tin Deacon.

voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_01.text: The noise is already up, Hank. That first clean exchange is going to tell us a lot.

voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_02.text: Look at the posture in both corners. Nobody wants to give away the center of the ring.

voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_openColor_03.text: The lights are hot, the crowd is ready, and both machines look settled. Now we find out who can execute.

voicepack.hank_underdog_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_underdog_01.text: This is the story of the circuit, Sparkplug. A garage build against Tidewater factory steel.

voicepack.hank_underdog_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_underdog_02.text: Homework was welded together in a garage. Nightjar rolled off a Meridian assembly line.

voicepack.hank_underdog_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_underdog_03.text: Money against grit tonight. Jackpot cost more than this whole neighborhood.

voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_01.text: Factory bots have never been hungry, Hank. Garage bots are always hungry.

voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_02.text: I was a garage bot. You learn to take a punch when you can't afford armor.

voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_underdogColor_03.text: Price tag doesn't block punches. Trust me, I checked.

voicepack.hank_rematch_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_rematch_01.text: These two have met before. Wildfire edged Rustbucket Rex on points in their last meeting.

voicepack.hank_rematch_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_rematch_02.text: There is history here. Rivet Queen edged Glacier on points in their last meeting.

voicepack.hank_final_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_final_01.text: Final round! Everything they have left goes into these 45 seconds.

voicepack.hank_final_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_final_02.text: This is it, the last round. Somebody has to empty the tank.

voicepack.hank_bigHead_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigHead_01.text: Big shot to the head by Graveyard Shift!

voicepack.hank_bigHead_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigHead_02.text: Dumpster Diva snaps Duchess's head back!

voicepack.hank_bigHead_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigHead_03.text: Clean! Mama Fixit lands right on the sensor array.

voicepack.hank_bigBody_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigBody_02.text: Right in the battery housing from Rustbucket Rex!

voicepack.hank_bigBody_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigBody_03.text: Steam Hammer goes downstairs and Tollbooth feels it.

voicepack.hank_bigBody_04.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bigBody_04.text: That body shot echoed through the whole building.

voicepack.hank_hay_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_hay_01.text: HAYMAKER! Old Faithful lands the big one!

voicepack.hank_hay_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_hay_02.text: Needle unloads the haymaker and it connects!

voicepack.hank_hay_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_hay_03.text: Oh! That haymaker could have knocked the paint off a bridge!

voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_01.text: That was power through the target, Hank. The question now is whether Paperweight can answer before the pressure builds.

voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_02.text: A clean haymaker changes the whole exchange. Mismatch has to get the guard back in place.

voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_hayColor_03.text: That shot landed with the kind of force that makes a corner rethink its plan.

voicepack.hank_crit_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_crit_01.text: Critical hit! Haybale found the gap in the armor!

voicepack.hank_crit_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_crit_02.text: Right through the seam! Critical from Little Brine!

voicepack.hank_crit_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_crit_03.text: That one found the opening. Cinderblock took a clean shot to the head.

voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_01.text: That is the detail to watch now: Needle's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_02.text: A clean opening like that can swing momentum. Pinball's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_critColor_03.text: The damage is real, but Channel Nine is still in this. Watch the next exchange.

voicepack.hank_sig_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sig_01.text: There it is, Lance Jab! Socket Jo lands the signature!

voicepack.hank_sig_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sig_02.text: Avalanche! That is what Glacier is known for!

voicepack.hank_sig_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sig_03.text: The signature connects! Pinball timed that perfectly.

voicepack.sparkplug_sigColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_sigColor_01.text: That timing was sharp, Hank. Night Shift's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_sigColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_sigColor_02.text: You could see Kettle Drum wait for the opening, and then the signature landed.

voicepack.hank_sigMiss_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sigMiss_01.text: Fridge Magnet read the Bell Tower and slipped it!

voicepack.hank_sigMiss_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sigMiss_02.text: Coil Flash misses! Undertow saw it coming a mile away.

voicepack.hank_sigMiss_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_sigMiss_03.text: Nothing but air on the Talon Draw!

voicepack.sparkplug_slipColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_slipColor_01.text: Good eyes. Read the shoulder, not the fist.

voicepack.sparkplug_slipColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_slipColor_03.text: Defense is just offense that waits.

voicepack.hank_feint_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_feint_01.text: Feint from Wreckless, testing Lamplighter's nerve.

voicepack.hank_feint_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_feint_02.text: Grudge shows it and pulls it back.

voicepack.sparkplug_blockColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_blockColor_01.text: Tight guard. You could hide a toaster behind that guard.

voicepack.sparkplug_blockColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_blockColor_03.text: Blocking all night is fine until your arms fall off. Literally.

voicepack.hank_combo_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_combo_01.text: Duchess puts three together in that exchange!

voicepack.hank_combo_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_combo_02.text: Combination from Harbormaster, and Cathedral is covering up!

voicepack.hank_combo_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_combo_03.text: Three clean connections in the sequence from Teakettle!

voicepack.sparkplug_comboColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_comboColor_01.text: That sequence opened up because Wildfire's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_comboColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_comboColor_02.text: The important part is the follow-through. Tollbooth kept the pressure on without giving Bus Stop a reset.

voicepack.hank_heat_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_heat_01.text: Paperweight is running hot. You can see the vents glowing.

voicepack.hank_heat_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_heat_02.text: Watch the heat gauge on Mismatch. That is overheating territory.

voicepack.hank_malf_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_malf_01.text: Cinderblock has a malfunction! a lead arm servo is jammed!

voicepack.hank_malf_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_malf_02.text: Trouble for Channel Nine. The lead arm servo is jammed!

voicepack.hank_malf_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_malf_03.text: Systems are glitching on Fridge Magnet!

voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_01.text: That is a real problem now. Cinderblock's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_02.text: The corner will have to adjust quickly; that system is not operating normally.

voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_malfColor_03.text: That changes the tactical picture. Sickle's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.hank_detach_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_detach_01.text: The arm is OFF! Thresher has torn Undertow's arm clean away!

voicepack.hank_detach_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_detach_02.text: Oh my! Lamplighter is down an arm! Sparks everywhere!

voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_01.text: Is that legal? Apparently that is legal.

voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_02.text: One arm. I have seen bots win with one arm. Not many.

voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_detachColor_03.text: Somebody grab that arm, they will want it back.

voicepack.hank_offline_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_offline_01.text: Nightjar's lead arm servo is offline!

voicepack.hank_offline_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_offline_02.text: The lead arm servo is jammed damage on Jackpot. That changes everything.

voicepack.sparkplug_offlineColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_offlineColor_01.text: That loss is visible in the way Cathedral has to move now. Fridge Magnet's head assembly is badly damaged

voicepack.sparkplug_offlineColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_offlineColor_02.text: The remaining systems will have to carry the load. This is a very different fight.

voicepack.hank_down_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_down_03.text: Oh! Sparky Malou hits the canvas!

voicepack.hank_kneel_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_kneel_01.text: Kiln is up to a knee, systems flickering.

voicepack.hank_kneel_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_kneel_02.text: Last Call props itself up on one arm. The lights are coming back on.

voicepack.hank_kneel_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_kneel_03.text: There is movement from Saint Sprocket!

voicepack.hank_rise_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_rise_01.text: Demo Day beats the count at 8!

voicepack.hank_rise_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_rise_02.text: Tow Truck Tess is UP! This crowd cannot believe it!

voicepack.hank_rise_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_rise_03.text: Back on its feet at 8! Rivet Queen is not done yet!

voicepack.sparkplug_riseColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_riseColor_02.text: I always said, the ten count is just a suggestion.

voicepack.sparkplug_riseColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_riseColor_03.text: That bot has a heart. Well, a capacitor. Same thing.

voicepack.hank_secondwind_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_secondwind_01.text: Second wind for Bus Stop! The backup cells kick in!

voicepack.sparkplug_secondwindColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_secondwindColor_01.text: That is a confirmed surge of power. Now Thresher has to turn it into a clean exchange.

voicepack.sparkplug_secondwindColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_secondwindColor_02.text: The reserve cells are working, but stamina will still matter in the closing rounds.

voicepack.hank_late_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_late_01.text: Ten seconds left in the round!

voicepack.hank_late_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_late_02.text: Ten seconds! Big finish from either corner?

voicepack.hank_bell_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bell_01.text: That is the end of round 2.

voicepack.hank_bell_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bell_02.text: There's the bell. End of round 2.

voicepack.hank_bellWin_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bellWin_01.text: I'd give that round to Sickle.

voicepack.hank_bellWin_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bellWin_02.text: Velvet took that round on my card.

voicepack.hank_bellWin_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bellWin_03.text: Clear round for Sparky Malou, I think.

voicepack.hank_bellEven_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bellEven_01.text: Close round. Could go either way.

voicepack.hank_bellEven_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_bellEven_02.text: Hard round to score. Judges earn their money on that one.

voicepack.hank_comeback_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_comeback_01.text: And now the tide is turning! Wildfire is taking over!

voicepack.hank_comeback_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_comeback_02.text: Night Shift has come all the way back in this fight!

voicepack.hank_danger_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_danger_01.text: The Foreman is in serious trouble here!

voicepack.hank_danger_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_danger_02.text: Homework is hurt, smoke pouring out!

voicepack.hank_danger_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_danger_03.text: One more clean shot could finish Monsoon.

voicepack.hank_ko_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_ko_01.text: IT IS ALL OVER! Kiln WINS IT!

voicepack.hank_ko_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_ko_02.text: That's it! Last Call has done it!

voicepack.hank_ko_03.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_ko_03.text: Stop the fight! Saint Sprocket wins!

voicepack.hank_counted_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_counted_01.text: Nine... TEN! Gaff Hook could not beat the count! Demo Day wins by knockout!

voicepack.hank_tko_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_tko_01.text: The referee steps in! Technical knockout for Tow Truck Tess!

voicepack.hank_tko_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_tko_02.text: That is a TKO! Rivet Queen wins!

voicepack.hank_decision_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_decision_01.text: We go to the scorecards. The Foreman wins by decision, 29–28, 28–29, and 29–28.

voicepack.hank_decision_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_decision_02.text: The judges have it 29–28, 28–29, and 29–28 for Homework!

voicepack.hank_choose_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_choose_01.text: The crowd wants it. Will Monsoon finish the job?

voicepack.hank_choose_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_choose_02.text: Here's the moment. Destroy or spare?

voicepack.hank_destroy_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_destroy_01.text: Gaff Hook rips the head right off! Graveyard Shift is scrap metal!

voicepack.hank_destroy_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_destroy_02.text: Oh! That is a full decapitation! The crowd goes crazy!

voicepack.sparkplug_destroyColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_destroyColor_02.text: And that is why I retired, Hank.

voicepack.sparkplug_destroyColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_destroyColor_03.text: I'll be taking that head home for the shelf. Kidding. Mostly.

voicepack.hank_spare_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_spare_01.text: Graveyard Shift walks away. Sportsmanship at Harbor Pit.

voicepack.hank_spare_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_spare_02.text: Dumpster Diva spares Mama Fixit. The crowd respects it.

voicepack.sparkplug_spareColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_spareColor_01.text: Class act. Somebody owes somebody a drink of oil.

voicepack.sparkplug_spareColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_spareColor_02.text: That is a fighter with a code.

voicepack.hank_idle_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_01.text: Mama Fixit came in 7 and 4. Beacon brings a 8 and 3 record.

voicepack.hank_idle_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_02.text: Rustbucket Rex is a brawler. Expect heavy hooks and haymakers.

voicepack.hank_idle_04.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_04.text: Weight check: Beacon at 126 kilos, Steam Hammer at 128.

voicepack.hank_idle_05.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_05.text: Rustbucket Rex runs a Stock firmware chip. Interesting choice.

voicepack.hank_idle_06.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_06.text: The The Ruiz Twins crew in Steam Hammer's corner have their welders ready.

voicepack.hank_idle_07.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_idle_07.text: Watch for the Aria Snap. Lamplighter telegraphs it: the shoulder draws back. Slip or step clear when the shoulder draws back, then punish the recovery.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_01.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_01.text: Keep your guard up, kids. That's free advice.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_02.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_02.text: Back in my day we had one punch and it was called the punch.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_03.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_03.text: I'm watching the battery meters. Somebody is going to fade.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_04.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_04.text: That footwork is cleaner than my oil filter.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_05.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_05.text: Ninety percent of this sport is not falling over.

voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_06.speaker: color
voicepack.sparkplug_idleColor_06.text: Hank, how many arms have you lost? Zero? Must be nice.

voicepack.hank_story_01.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_story_01.text: Rustbucket Rex comes out of the Rust Belt. Patched together from three wrecks behind a tire shop. Swings like it owes somebody money.

voicepack.hank_story_02.speaker: pbp
voicepack.hank_story_02.text: A little about Grudge: Lost its first twelve fights, then won twenty-seven. It remembers every one of the losses.

ring.open.speaker: ring
ring.open.text: Ladies and gentlemen... welcome to the Scrapyard Circuit!
